name: Cordovilla (Spain)
description: Square crimson flag charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Cordovilla (a castle and a cross of Saint James on white) between three white crosses.
history: Municipal flag of Cordovilla; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
